summary: Bulk Messaging Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 19/19 PASSED, Frontend: ALL PASSED. Feature enables admin to send SMS/WhatsApp messages (currently simulated). API settings, recipient count, message sending (simulated), and history all work correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/messaging/settings returns configuration status
Backend: POST /api/messaging/settings updates provider, sender ID, phone number
Backend: GET /api/messaging/recipients/count returns total and breakdown by warehouse
Backend: Recipient count filter by warehouse works
Backend: Recipient count filter by category (domestic/commercial) works
Backend: POST /api/messaging/send with channel=sms works (simulated)
Backend: POST /api/messaging/send with channel=whatsapp works (simulated)
Backend: POST /api/messaging/send with channel=both works (simulated)
Backend: Empty message correctly rejected with 400
Backend: Invalid channel correctly rejected with 400
Backend: GET /api/messaging/logs returns message history
Backend: GET /api/messaging/logs/{id} returns detail for specific log
Backend: Non-existent log returns 404
Backend: All messaging endpoints return 403 for non-admin users
Backend: Customer create with phone field works correctly
Frontend: Bulk Messaging page accessible at /bulk-messaging for admin
Frontend: Bulk Messaging link visible in sidebar for admin only
Frontend: Non-admin users redirected away from /bulk-messaging
Frontend: Compose Message tab has channel select, message textarea, send button
Frontend: Recipients count section displays correctly
Frontend: Message History tab shows past messages with status badges
Frontend: API Settings tab has SMS and WhatsApp configuration fields
Frontend: Configuration badges show 'Not Configured' when API credentials missing
Frontend: Alert shown about simulated messages when API not configured
Frontend: Customer Management page shows Phone column in table
Frontend: Add Customer form has Phone (for SMS/WhatsApp) input field
critical_code_review_comments: MOCKED: Bulk messaging send endpoint returns simulated results when API credentials are not configured - this is expected behavior for placeholder implementation
seed_data_creation: Test customers with phone numbers were created and deleted during backend testing. Message logs were created as part of simulated sending tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Messaging feature is fully functional with placeholder implementation. Key components: 1) GET/POST /api/messaging/settings for API configuration, 2) GET /api/messaging/recipients/count for recipient filtering, 3) POST /api/messaging/send for sending messages (currently simulated), 4) GET /api/messaging/logs for history, 5) All endpoints admin-only. Frontend has 3 tabs: Compose Message, Message History, API Settings. Messages are simulated when no API credentials configured. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_messaging.py

tested_features_summary.messaging_settings_api: WORKING - GET/POST for SMS and WhatsApp configuration
tested_features_summary.recipient_count_api: WORKING - Returns total and breakdown by warehouse
tested_features_summary.send_message_api: WORKING - Simulated mode when no API credentials
tested_features_summary.frontend_compose_tab: WORKING - Channel select, message input, send button

tested_features_summary.frontend_settings_tab: WORKING - SMS and WhatsApp configuration fields

mocked_api_note: POST /api/messaging/send returns simulated success when no SMS/WhatsApp API credentials are configured. This is the expected placeholder behavior for future integration with providers like Twilio, MSG91, or Meta WhatsApp Business API.
